script_text: Stop, Aries: Mars is not playing nice with your love life. On June 17, 2026, Venus in your 4th House of home and family squares Mars, your ruling planet, in your 2nd House of money and self-worth. The Sun in your 3rd House also squares Neptune in your 1st, so feelings can blur the facts. If you're single, a magnetic type may appear through family, neighbors, or a domestic errand; don't confuse chemistry with commitment. If attached, a household expense or family comment can trigger your classic Fire-sign reaction—pause before answering. Career and money: a message in your 3rd House points to a paid opportunity, commission, or contract revision; read the fine print before signing. Blessing: Pluto sextiles Uranus across your 11th and 3rd Houses, opening a surprising ally or group contact. Avoid impulsive spending, then follow for tomorrow's reading.
